title: Ongoing Lean formalisation of the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem

source.citation: Buzzard et al., FLT project blueprint (own exposition of a Taylor-Wiles/Kisin-style proof; draws on Cornell-Silverman-Stevens, DDT, BLGGT, Voight, Katz-Mazur, ...)
source.evidence: README: "An ongoing multi-author open source project to formalise a proof of Fermat's Last Theorem"; blueprint organised as miniprojects (adeles, Frobenius elements, Fujisaki, Hecke operators) written for the project; cites ddt, blggt, voightbook, corvallis etc. only for background.
